model.overall: 85% opponent-adjusted four-unit strength + 15% uncapped opponent-adjusted scoring margin, cumulative AP-ranked win bonuses, asymmetric season SOS, -0.20 Z per loss, FCS underperformance penalties, and a decaying current-season preseason anchor through Week 6.
model.unit_weights: Equal PO RO PD RD; passing PPA/success/explosiveness 45/45/10, rushing 40/40/20.
model.opponent_adjustment: Chronological nonrecursive opponent unit strength frozen at pregame time.
model.margin: Uncapped opponent-adjusted scoring margin, 15% statistical performance.
model.fcs: Additional penalties for FCS wins by ten or fewer or FCS losses, overall only.
model.preseason_anchor: Week 1: 100%; Week 2: 75%; Week 3: 55%; Week 4: 40%; Week 5: 20%; Week 6: 5%; Week 7 onward: 0%. Current-season preseason consensus required.
